lawful_dependency_graph.registration_law: A product binds only determinants it actually consumed. A future/revised authority is never pre-registered.
lawful_dependency_graph.successor_resolution: by authority identity (authority_id + authority_version) matched against the affected product's own consumed determinants; never by tuple position

owner_gap.statement: AuthorityInvalidationReceipt requires recompilation_pairs to cover exactly the affected dependent set, and AuthorityMaintenanceExecutor._recompile requires every affected dependent to move to a NEW exact ref. An affected product with no lawful replacement has no lawful representation.
counterexample_paths: promote_current(recompiler=None) -> 'affected dependents require an explicit deterministic recompiler'
promote_current(recompiler=identity) -> 'affected dependent recompilation must produce a new exact ref'

documents_what_would_close_the_gap: A lawful representation for an affected dependent whose replacement is unavailable (for example an explicit typed noncurrent/deferred state in the owner receipt vocabulary), OR
an owner transition that can lawfully express 'affected but not replaceable' without requiring a fabricated replacement exact ref.
not_claimed: no second lifecycle owner was built
no multi-conditioner or joint dependency closure
